status: template defaults; replace the palette and name with your own brand

typography.note: Inter is bundled under the SIL Open Font License. To use another family, add its font files to brand-kit/fonts and starter/composition/assets/fonts, then update build.py's @font-face block.

captions.style: Text only. White over footage with a thin dark glyph edge; ink colour over paper with no edge. One position and size in every scene. Each caption ends at punctuation; the next word starts a new caption. No rotation, bounce or background panel.

camera.rule: Anchor every crop to one stable base-of-neck point, centred horizontally, and only change scale between cuts. Never follow eyes, head or hands, and never re-centre at pause trims. Pick a fresh anchor when the camera setup changes.

motion.effects: none by default: no neon, glow, shake or heavy grade
motion.diagrams: draw strokes in over 0.4 to 0.5 s; reveal nodes with short fades; keep every connector clear of text and objects

diagrams.style: Paper background with a 48px micro-grid, unfilled outlines, uniform 4px stroke, slightly irregular arrows with straight arrowheads, labels at least 33px on the 1080px canvas.
